title: Proxy-unaware HTTPS client sends raw TLS to the forward proxy
symptoms: TLS handshake fails when the client ignores HTTPS_PROXY
Raw ClientHello reaches Squid instead of an HTTP CONNECT request
conditions: The Compose runtime uses iptables DNAT for port 443 as defense in depth
The client does not use the configured forward proxy; this is not the gVisor proxy-only path
A TLS error alone does not prove a domain ACL denial or certificate failure
rootCause: Squid's explicit forward-proxy listener expects HTTP CONNECT, not a raw TLS ClientHello. DNAT blocks bypass attempts but cannot translate TLS into CONNECT.

probe.expect: Review checked-in proxy setup and the client's documented proxy support without dumping its environment or sending traffic; verify whether the client uses CONNECT.

action: Configure the client to use AWF's explicit HTTPS forward proxy. JVM clients can use injected system properties, while Maven needs settings.xml proxy configuration. Do not treat raw-TLS rejection as a reason to bypass Squid, open direct egress or disable certificate checks.
